definitions.overall: Weighted 'overall' = the candidate population covered by the sampled buckets (repos that code search returned through the randomly selected size buckets of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md files), scaled to GitHub-wide via inclusion probabilities: each repo is weighted by 1 / (P(it entered the candidate pool) x P(it was drawn within its stratum)). 'GitHub-wide' means public, active, non-archived repositories that code search indexes (see limitations).
definitions.strata: established = stars >= 10; long_tail = stars 0-9; both: not a fork, not archived, pushed within 180 days, size 200 B-100 KB, non-dev.
definitions.unit: the repo (also the bootstrap cluster); one row per repo and file type
definitions.sensitivity: trimmed = weights capped at the 99th percentile of the cell's weights; delta = trimmed - untrimmed; sensitive = |delta| exceeds the CI half-width. Weights are nearly two-valued, so trimming is often a no-op (n_trimmed = 0).

percentiles_note: weighted percentiles; cells with n < 30 omitted; always_loaded_tokens excludes nested-only repos
